scope: How far each crossing cable can be slid before it meets something

method.contact: triangle overlap on evaluated meshes, never boxes
method.boxes_used_only_to: choose which neighbours to test at each step
method.attachment: already within 0.001 m of the cable and named with one of ['_p00', '_p01', '_p03', '_p05']; measured, not guessed from the name
method.set_aside_from_the_sweep: every part whose triangles already meet the cable where it stands, which is what the cable rests on and is held by, and the run it already crosses

policies.everything_it_meets: every part the cable reaches, in the order it reaches them
policies.without_the_air_main: the air main set aside, its box being far larger than its pipe
policies.without_the_air_main_or_what_holds_it: also the fittings of every source group the cable is attached to, which move with it

method.air_main: objects whose name carries ['source_0779', 'source_0780'] are reported both ways, because their boxes are far larger than the pipe inside them
method.closest_gap: the smaller of the two vertex-to-surface measurements, an upper bound

what_this_does_not_give: how far the cable should move, which is a required separation and belongs to the real cable
the bend radius a moved run would need
whether the cable can reach its fittings after a move: the ends are held and do not slide
room along Y or downward, which was not asked for
room for a route that is not a straight slide
any judgement of whether a move is acceptable

contacts_before_the_copies.why: so a contact found in the candidate is not read as something work 3 caused
